newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: CHINESE PM SIGNS ECONOMIC AGREEMENTS IN ZAMBIA.
newsitem.headline: CHINESE PM SIGNS ECONOMIC AGREEMENTS IN ZAMBIA.

text.p: Chinese premier Li Peng arrived in the Zambian capital on a three-day state visit on Monday and signed two economic agreements with President Frederick Chiluba.

The agreements included a $11.2 million interest-free loan to the Tanzania-Zambia Railway Authority (TAZARA), which links the two countries and is jointly owned by both governments, and a $3.6 million grant to the Zambian government.
Peng told journalists after the signing that China was not in a position to give aid to other developing countries but wanted to strengthen economic ties with them through investment.
"We are entering a new stage of cooperation on the basis of equal and mutual benefit," Peng said.
"China will encourage its businessmen to set up business ventures in Zambia. We hope for more co-operation in the copper and agricultural fields," he added.
President Chiluba said his government was happy with changes in the two countries' economic relationship.
"We are happy that...Chinese support has changed from charity to economic collaboration," he said.
"We are delighted to learn that Chinese mining groups are interested in our mines," he added.
The Chiluba government has put up Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM), the company responsible for some 90 percent of the country's foreign reciepts, for sale.
Six bidders for final negotitations on the sale of ZCCM's assets were shortlisted last month.

They are AUR Resources, Kafue Consortium (comprising Avmin Ltd , Noranda Mining , Phelps Dodge and the Commonwealth Development Corp), the Binani Group, First Quantam Minerals Ltd, the Metorex Consortium (including Randex and the Crew Group) and Sterlite Industries (India) Ltd.
Peng's 130-strong entourage includes leading Chinese businessmen and economic experts.
The Chinese premier is on a six-country visit in Africa, and will travel to Nigeria, Mozambique, Cameroon, Gabon and Tanzania later during the month.
